Yet one by one, through the damp chill, they all emerged: Jealous, Panda, Ordos, Soul, WhoFlungDung, Arby3, Jets, TheBigOne, and LisaMVP. Every throat still drew breath, but the miraculous lack of a corpse offered no comfort. 

Someone had hunted in the dark; someone else had stopped them. The violence had merely stalled, and as the town hall doors swung wide, the gathered crowd prepared to tear each other apart in the daylight.
